title: Bukhar Me Kaunsa Test Karaye? Deoria Ki Lakshan Guide
description: Bukhar, peeli aankh, pyaas, thakan ya jhunjhuni — Deoria me kis lakshan par kaunsa test hota hai, kab turant aspatal jaana hai, aur sample ghar se kaise dein.

takeaways: Log test ka naam dhoondhte hain, lekin ghar se nikalte hain ek takleef lekar. Ek hi lakshan ki kai wajah hoti hai — isliye doctor ek test nahi, aksar do-teen test saath likhta hai.
Kuch lakshan me test ka intezaar nahi kiya jaata: bachche ko bukhar ke saath jhatke, saans ki dikkat, seene me dard, khoon ki ulti, ya garbhwati mahila ko peeliya. In me pehle aspatal, test baad me.
Saath ka lakshan test badal deta hai. Bukhar ke saath kanpkanpi, bukhar ke saath peeli aankh aur bukhar ke saath peshab me jalan — teeno me pehla test alag hai.

Test ka daam is baat par tay hota hai ki kaunsa roop likha hai — akela TSH ya poora thyroid profile, akela NS1 ya teeno dengue test. Parche ki photo booking me bhejne se galat panel aur doosra kharcha dono bachte hain.

sections.heading: Lakshan Pehle, Test Baad Me — Ye Guide Kaise Padhein
sections.lead: Takleef ka naam dhoondhiye, test ka naam apne aap milega.
blocks: Deoria me jab koi phone karta hai to wo aksar ye nahi kehta ki "mujhe HbA1c karana hai". Wo kehta hai: "maa ko teen din se bukhar hai", "papa ko pyaas bahut lagti hai", "bitiya ki aankhein peeli lag rahi hain". Test ka naam baad me aata hai, takleef pehle. Ye guide usi kram me likhi gayi hai — pehle lakshan, phir wo jaanch jo doctor aam taur par us lakshan par likhta hai, aur phir us jaanch ki poori guide ka link.

Ek baat shuru me hi saaf kar dein. Ek lakshan ki kai wajah ho sakti hai. Thakan khoon ki kami se bhi hoti hai, thyroid se bhi, sugar se bhi, aur neend poori na hone se bhi. Isliye neeche har lakshan ke saath ek se zyada test likhe hain — ye aapko sab kuch karwane ki salah nahi hai, ye batane ke liye hai ki doctor kis soch se test chunta hai.

note.title: Ye jaanch ki guide hai, ilaaj ya diagnosis nahi
note.text: Yahan likha hai ki kis lakshan par aam taur par kaunsi jaanch hoti hai. Yahan ye nahi likha ki aapko kaunsi bimari hai ya kaunsi dawa leni hai. Report ka matlab doctor nikaalta hai. Aur agar lakshan tez hain, to neeche wala agla section pehle padhiye.

sections.heading: Pehle Ye Dekh Lijiye — Kin Lakshanon Me Test Nahi, Seedha Aspatal
sections.lead: Lab ka kaam jaanch hai. Emergency ka kaam aspatal ka hai.
blocks: Deoria, Kushinagar aur Gorakhpur ki patti me barsaat ke baad bachchon me dimaagi bukhar ke maamle aate rahe hain, aur yahi wajah hai ki is list ko sabse upar rakha gaya hai. Neeche likhi kisi bhi haalat me ghar par sample ka slot book karke intezaar mat kijiye. Mareez ko najdeeki aspatal le jaaiye; zaroori test wahan bhi ho jaate hain aur baad me bhi ho sakte hain.

list: Bachche ko tez bukhar ke saath jhatke aayein, wo behosh jaisa ho jaaye, gardan akad jaaye ya baar-baar ulti kare.
Saans lene me dikkat ho, hont ya nakhun neele padne lagein, ya mareez baat karte-karte haanfne lage.
Seene me dabaav ya dard ho jo baayein haath, jabde ya peeth tak jaaye — iski jaanch ECG se hoti hai, jo hamari service nahi hai; ye aspatal ka kaam hai.
Khoon ki ulti ho, latrine kaali ya khooni aaye, ya naak-masudon se khoon na ruke.
Garbhwati mahila ki aankhein ya peshab peela ho jaaye.
Sugar ke mareez me bahut susti, ulti, gehri tez saans ya behoshi ho.
Peshab lagbhag band ho jaaye, ya chehre aur pairon me achanak bahut sujan aa jaaye.

blocks: Bachchon ke bukhar par Deoria ke liye likhi chetavani
me bhi hai. Baaki sab lakshan — jo dheere-dheere aa rahe hain aur jin me mareez chal-phir raha hai — un par neeche ki guide kaam aayegi.

Typhoid me Widal likha hai, typhoid IgM card likha hai, ya blood culture — culture sabse zyada samay aur kharche wala hai, aur sabse bharosemand bhi.

sections.heading: Pyaas, Baar-Baar Peshab, Ghaav Na Bharna — Deoria Me Sugar Test Aur HbA1c Checkup
sections.lead: Sugar ke lakshan dheere aate hain, isliye der se pakde jaate hain.
blocks: Bahut pyaas lagna, raat me do-teen baar peshab ke liye uthna, chhota ghaav hafton tak na bharna, bina koshish wazan girna, aankhon ke aage dhundhla lagna, ya pairon me jalan — ye sab sugar ki taraf ishara karte hain. Deoria me bahut se log in lakshanon ko umar ya garmi ka asar maan kar saalon tak test nahi karate.
Deoria me sugar test aur HbA1c checkup ke teen aam roop hain, aur teeno alag sawaal ka jawab dete hain:

list: Fasting blood sugar — 8 se 10 ghante khaali pet ke baad ka sugar. Aaj subah ki haalat batata hai.
PP sugar — khaana khaane ke kareeb do ghante baad. Batata hai ki sharir khaane ke baad sugar kaise sambhaalta hai.
HbA1c — pichhle lagbhag teen mahine ka ausat. Ismein fasting nahi lagti, isliye jinka khaane ka samay tay nahi, unke liye ye sabse aasan hai.

note.title: Khoon ki kami ho to HbA1c akela kaafi nahi
note.text: Purvi UP me khoon ki kami bahut aam hai, khaas kar mahilaon me. Iron ki kami me HbA1c ka number thoda gumraah kar sakta hai, isliye doctor kai baar saath me CBC ya fasting sugar bhi likhta hai. Pregnancy me sugar jaanchne ka tareeka bhi alag hota hai — wahan doctor jo test likhe, wahi karwaiye.

sections.heading: Thakan, Baal Jhadna, Wazan Badalna — Thyroid Test TSH Price In Deoria Aur Pehle Kya Dekhein
sections.lead: Thyroid ke lakshan kai aur bimariyon se milte hain.
blocks: Hamesha thakan, thand zyada lagna, baal jhadna, bina wajah wazan badhna ya ghatna, periods ka gadbad hona, dil ki dhadkan tez lagna, ya gale ke saamne sujan — in par doctor aksar thyroid ki jaanch likhta hai. Lekin yahi lakshan khoon ki kami, vitamin B12 ki kami aur vitamin D ki kami me bhi dikhte hain. Isliye akela thyroid normal aane par baat khatam nahi hoti.
Thyroid test TSH price in Deoria is baat par tay hota hai ki kaunsa roop likha hai:

list: Sirf TSH — screening aur dawa ki dose dekhne ke liye aksar yahi kaafi hota hai. Ye sabse kam kharche wala roop hai.
Thyroid profile (T3, T4, TSH) — pehli baar jaanch me ya jab doctor ko poori tasveer chahiye.
Free T3 aur Free T4 — kuch haalat me doctor total ki jagah free likhta hai; naam milta-julta hai lekin test alag hai, isliye parche ki photo zaroor bhejiye.

note.title: Sample se pehle do baatein
note.text: Thyroid ki goli chal rahi hai to use sample dene ke baad lijiye. Biotin ya baalon-nakhun wala multivitamin le rahe hain to booking ke waqt bata dijiye — ye hormone ki report ko bigaad sakta hai, aur doctor aksar 2 se 3 din pehle band karne ko kehta hai.

blocks: Kis roop ka daam kyun alag hai aur TSH dobara kab karana hai, wo
me hai. Thakan ke saath chakkar ya jhunjhuni bhi hai, to neeche wala khoon aur vitamin ka section bhi padhiye.

sections.heading: Aankh Ya Peshab Peela — Deoria Me LFT Aur Jaundice Ki Jaanch
sections.lead: Peeliya ek bimari nahi, ek ishara hai. Jaanch batati hai ki kiska.
blocks: Aankh ka safed hissa peela lagna, peshab ka gaadha peela rang, bhookh khatam ho jaana, ulti jaisa mann aur bahut kamzori — gaon me ise seedha "peeliya" keh diya jaata hai, aur kai ghar jhaad-phoonk ya nuskhe me hafta nikaal dete hain. Deoria me LFT aur jaundice ki jaanch ko der tak taalna sabse mehngi galti hai, kyunki peeliya ki wajah alag-alag hoti hai aur har wajah ka ilaaj alag.

list: LFT (liver function test) — bilirubin (total aur direct), SGPT, SGOT, alkaline phosphatase aur protein. Yahi batata hai ki peeliya kitna hai aur kis tarah ka lagta hai.
Hepatitis A IgM aur Hepatitis E IgM — ganda paani is ilaake me peeliya ki sabse aam wajah hai, khaas kar barsaat aur baadh ke baad.
HBsAg (Hepatitis B) — doctor zaroorat samjhe to likhta hai.
CBC — kuch peeliya khoon ke tootne se bhi hota hai, jo CBC me dikhta hai.

note.title: Do haalat me intezaar nahi
note.text: Garbhwati mahila ko peeliya ho, ya naye janme bachche ki twacha aur aankh peeli dikhe — dono me usi din doctor ya aspatal. Naye bachche ke peeliya ki jaanch aur ilaaj aspatal me hi hota hai.

blocks: LFT me kya-kya aata hai aur baadh ke baad Deoria me peeliya kyun badhta hai, wo
me vistaar se hai. LFT me fasting aam taur par zaroori nahi hoti, isliye mareez ko khaali pet rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.

sections.heading: Chakkar, Saans Phoolna, Haath-Pair Me Jhunjhuni — Khoon Aur Vitamin Ki Jaanch
sections.lead: Deoria me sabse zyada anadekhi hone wale lakshan yahi hain.
blocks: Seedhi chadhne par saans phoolna, baithe se uthne par chakkar, chehre aur nakhun ka peelapan, haath-pair me chitiyan chalna ya sunnpan, aur yaad na rehna — in lakshanon ko aksar "kamzori" keh kar taal diya jaata hai. Kamzori koi jaanch nahi hai. Uske peeche ki wajah dhoondhne ke liye aam taur par ye test likhe jaate hain:

list: CBC — haemoglobin ke saath khoon ki koshikaon ka size bhi batata hai, jisse ishara milta hai ki kami iron ki taraf hai ya vitamin ki.
Ferritin — sharir me jama iron. Haemoglobin theek hone par bhi ye kam ho sakta hai.
Vitamin B12 — shaakahaari khaan-paan wale gharon me aam kami; jhunjhuni aur sunnpan isi se jude ho sakte hain.
Vitamin D — haddi aur maanspeshiyon ka dard, lagatar thakan.

blocks: Sirf haemoglobin dekh kar iron ki goli shuru kar dena aadha ilaaj ho sakta hai. Kyun, aur kaunsa test pehle — wo
me hai. In me se kisi test me fasting nahi lagti.

sections.heading: Peshab Me Jalan, Pairon Me Sujan, Jodon Me Dard — Urine Aur Kidney Ki Jaanch
sections.lead: Teen alag takleef, lekin jaanch aksar ek hi sample se shuru hoti hai.

list: Peshab me jalan, baar-baar lagna, badbu ya dhundhlapan — urine routine pehla test hai. Doctor ko infection ki pakki jaanch aur sahi dawa chahiye ho to urine culture likhta hai, jismein 48 se 72 ghante lagte hain. Culture ka sample antibiotic shuru hone se pehle ho to sabse saaf aata hai.

Subah aankh ke neeche ya shaam ko pairon me sujan, peshab me jhaag, ya sugar-BP ke purane mareez — doctor aksar KFT (creatinine, urea, electrolytes) aur urine ki jaanch likhta hai; sugar ke mareez me urine microalbumin bhi.

Jodon me dard, khaas kar pair ke angoothe me sujan — doctor uric acid likh sakta hai. Subah jodon me akdan aur kai jodon me dard ho to doctor alag jaanch likhta hai; wo parche ke hisaab se booking me jud jaati hai.

faqs.question: Bukhar me kaunsa test karaye — kya ek hi test se sab pata chal jaata hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Bukhar ki kai wajah hoti hai, isliye doctor aksar CBC ke saath dengue, malaria ya typhoid me se wo test likhta hai jo bukhar ke din aur saath ke lakshan se mel khaata hai. Kanpkanpi ho to malaria, badan aur aankh ke peeche dard ho to dengue, aur dheere badhta bukhar ho to typhoid ki jaanch aam hai. Pehle hi din sab test karwana aksar kaam nahi aata.

faqs.question: Deoria me dengue typhoid test price kitna hai?
faqs.answer: Ye is par tay hota hai ki parche par kya likha hai — sirf NS1, ya NS1 ke saath IgM aur IgG; Widal, typhoid IgM ya blood culture. Har test ka likha hua rate Deoria ki price list me hai, aur fever panel ka rate booking ke waqt sample se pehle bata diya jaata hai. Ghar se sample lene ka koi alag charge nahi hai.

faqs.question: Sugar check karane ke liye HbA1c karayein ya fasting sugar?
faqs.answer: Dono alag cheez batate hain. Fasting sugar aaj subah ki haalat batata hai aur 8 se 10 ghante khaali pet chahiye. HbA1c pichhle lagbhag teen mahine ka ausat batata hai aur usme fasting nahi lagti. Pehli jaanch me doctor aksar dono ya saath me PP sugar likhta hai. Khoon ki kami ho to HbA1c akele par nahi chala jaata.

faqs.question: Thyroid ke liye sirf TSH kaafi hai ya poora profile karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Screening aur dawa ki dose dekhne ke liye aksar sirf TSH kaafi hota hai, aur wo kam kharche wala bhi hai. Pehli baar jaanch me ya kuch khaas haalat me doctor poora thyroid profile ya Free T3-T4 likhta hai. Jo parche par likha ho wahi karwaiye — naam milte-julte hain lekin test alag hain.

faqs.question: Aankhein peeli hain — ghar par LFT ka sample de sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, LFT aur Hepatitis A/E ki jaanch ka sample ghar se liya ja sakta hai aur aam taur par fasting nahi lagti. Lekin garbhwati mahila ko peeliya ho, naye janme bachche me peeliya dikhe, ya peeliya ke saath behoshi, khoon ki ulti ya bahut susti ho, to usi din aspatal jaaiye.

faqs.question: Seene me dard ya lambi khaansi ki jaanch bhi ghar par ho jaayegi?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Seene ke dard ki jaanch ECG aur aspatal me hoti hai, aur lambi khaansi me chest X-ray tatha balgam ki jaanch lagti hai — ye hamari service nahi hain. Seene me dard ho to seedha aspatal jaaiye. Do hafte se zyada khaansi ho to doctor ko dikhaiye; TB ki balgam jaanch sarkari aspatal me muft hoti hai.

faqs.question: Ek hi mareez ke kai lakshan hain — kya alag-alag din sample dena hoga?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par nahi. Zyadatar khoon ki jaanch ek hi baar ke sample se ho jaati hai, aur urine ka container usi visit me de diya jaata hai. Fasting wala test likha ho to slot subah ka rakhiye, taaki baaki test bhi usi sample me ho jaayein.
